hero.heading: Meet Tiger
hero.body: I'm a big, fluffy German Shepherd and this is MY website! I love running, playing fetch, and being the goodest boy ever. Welcome to my corner of the internet! 🐕
hero.subheading: The goodest boy on the internet. Loyal, fluffy, and absolutely convinced that every visitor is here to pet him.

bio.heading: More than a dog. A whole personality.
bio.body: My name is Tiger and I'm a German Shepherd! I have a beautiful golden and black coat, big pointy ears, and the waggiest tail you've ever seen. I love going on walks, chasing squirrels (I never catch them 😅), and cuddling on the sofa. My favourite treat is peanut butter and my favourite game is tug-of-war. I am the best dog in the whole world — my owner said so!

items.label: Superpower
items.value: Hearing the treat bag from three rooms away 👂

bio.label: About Tiger
bio.body1: Tiger is a 3-year-old German Shepherd with the heart of a lion and the appetite of a small bear. He joined the family as a tiny fluffball and has since grown into the most dramatic, lovable, and occasionally chaotic member of the household.
bio.body2: His hobbies include: chasing tennis balls (never returning them), barking at the mailman, stealing socks, and performing award-winning zoomies at 6 AM. He is also an expert at the puppy eyes technique and has never once used it for evil.

funFacts.heading: Things you should know about Tiger
funFacts.body: Did you know German Shepherds are one of the smartest dogs ever? Here are some super cool things about my breed!

items.title: Natural Protector
items.body: German Shepherds are one of the most loyal and protective breeds in the world. Tiger takes his guard-dog duties very seriously — especially when squirrels are involved.

items.title: Lightning Fast
items.body: Tiger can reach speeds of up to 30 mph when chasing a tennis ball. He has never once caught a squirrel, but not for lack of trying.

items.title: Incredibly Smart
items.body: German Shepherds rank 3rd in dog intelligence. Tiger learned sit, stay, and shake in a single afternoon — then immediately forgot stay.

items.title: Pure Love
items.body: Despite his tough exterior, Tiger is a total softie. He insists on sleeping at the foot of the bed and gives the best morning zoomies.

items.title: Champion Napper
items.body: Tiger sleeps an average of 12 hours a day. He has perfected the art of the dramatic flop and the slow-motion couch takeover.

items.title: Natural Model
items.body: Tiger has an uncanny ability to look directly at the camera at exactly the right moment. His best side? All of them.

funFacts.label: Fun Facts
funFacts.subheading: He is a complex individual with many layers. Most of those layers are fur.
